items.title: Scent Confidence and Premium Gifting Release
items.description: Release focused on guided scent discovery, product confidence, gift configuration, and occasion-sensitive delivery promises.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase shopper confidence through clearer scent, ingredient, review, and occasion guidance.
Increase purchase conversion from guided finder and gift builder sessions.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase premium basket quality through better set, wrap, sample, and personalization paths.

productBricks.change: Improve scent, routine, occasion, and recipient recommendation logic.
Add deadline-aware gift builder and card/wrap eligibility.
Publish clearer scent-note, routine, and refill education modules.

deliveryChannels.change: Release updated discovery and gift builder screens.
Release gift configuration and promise orchestration services.

items.title: Member Replenishment and Refill Release
items.description: Release focused on member reorder timing, refill compatibility clarity, and personalized benefit application.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase the share of members who reorder or refill before product depletion.
Reduce confusion around refillable product formats and compatible containers.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase repeat purchases through timely, relevant reminders and low-friction reorder.
Increase refill adoption among eligible products.

productBricks.change: Improve depletion prediction and reminder acceptance logic.
Expose clearer refill compatibility and sustainability benefit explanations.
Apply member refill benefits and reward messaging.

deliveryChannels.change: Release refill and reorder surfaces to iOS.
Release refill and reorder surfaces to Android.
Release replenishment signals and next-best-action decisions.

items.title: Advisor Service and Store Execution Release
items.description: Release focused on advisor consultation context, stock accuracy, appointment handling, and store launch task completion.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase advisor ability to recommend the right products and continue service across channels.
Improve local stock and pickup readiness for assisted and digital orders.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase assisted revenue through better recommendations, stock recovery, and checkout.
Reduce broken store promises and endless-aisle misses.

productBricks.change: Improve consultation note capture, saved recommendations, and consent handling.
Tighten store availability, reservation, and pickup readiness state.
Add campaign and launch execution tasks with completion evidence.

deliveryChannels.change: Release advisor consultation and store task updates.
Release assisted checkout and stock recovery updates.

items.title: Launch and Claims Governance Release
items.description: Release focused on product data quality, claim approval traceability, supplier evidence, and cross-market launch readiness.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase operator confidence that product data, claims, evidence, market restrictions, and store tasks are ready before launch.
Increase the share of claims linked to formula, supplier, safety, or refill substantiation evidence.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase priority launches reaching first-sale date without material claim, data, or market restriction defects.
Reduce SKU corrections after channel publication.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase trust in product pages by improving ingredient, claim, and refill accuracy.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Improve repeat potential by reducing post-purchase claim and usage surprises.

customerKPIs.expectedImpact: Improve launch execution by giving stores clearer tasks and evidence requirements.

businessKPIs.expectedImpact: Increase advisor confidence in new collections and gift sets.

productBricks.change: Improve launch readiness checks and market scope state.
Reduce product setup defects with stronger validation.
Add claim approval traceability and restriction checks.
Link sourcing evidence to launch gates and customer-facing claims.

deliveryChannels.change: Release product data validation and claim publication services.
Release approved product data exports for partners and franchise operators.
